journal_text: Onakhe said: "The early Tumerok settlers of this lands abandoned their Takeru when they withdrew to the shelters before the Devastation. In the ages since, the Takeru have forgotten us. We have returned, but the Takeru no longer answer to our call. Instead, they attack all who approach them. It is with great sadness that I must ask you to help us to destroy them, before they can cause greater harm to our people."
